post.description:
Turn the Sales Rep's Turkish message into a Quote and explain it in Turkish.

Each client IP may send 20 messages an hour (configurable); past that the answer is `429`
with a `Retry-After` header, whatever the body holds.

Gemini reads the conversation and calls the `create_quote` tool, which runs the same quote
creation as `POST /quotes` (Address geocoding, PVGIS, TCMB, Narrative, storage) and stores
the Quote. The reply explains the Quote; every figure in it is filled from the Quote, never
written by the model. The response gives the Quote's id, Quote Number and document link.
The model never sets Coordinates: the Address is always geocoded.

When something a Quote needs is missing, the assistant asks for all of it in one Turkish
question (`reply`) and lists the fields in `missing_fields`; answer in a further message and
the Quote is created once everything is there. When Quote creation fails (Address not found,
invalid value, no viable system, unsupported Subscriber Group, a service unavailable), the
reply explains in Turkish what to change. A reply without a Quote may hold digits only as
the Sales Rep wrote them; if the model breaks that twice, a fixed Turkish reply is used. If
the three calls or the time budget run out without a Quote, the reply asks to restate the
information (200, no Quote).

The server keeps no conversation state: send the whole conversation every time (1 to 20
messages of at most 2000 characters, the last one from the `user`). At most one Quote is
created per request, and the model is called at most three times within a total time
budget, which covers the model calls and the tools together. If the model's reply after the
Quote breaks the placeholder rules, or the model fails after the Quote was created, the
reply is a fixed Turkish confirmation with the Quote Number, each option's capacity and
total price, and the document link.

**Privacy.** The Sales Rep's messages are sent to Gemini and may include the Customer's name
and Address. Gemini's free tier may use submitted content for training. Do not send what
must stay private.

Without a Gemini key (`SUNQUOTE_GEMINI_API_KEY`) this endpoint answers 503 "assistant not
configured" and the rest of the API works as usual. When the model is unavailable and no
Quote exists yet it answers 503 "assistant unavailable". When the day's global Gemini
budget is spent (ADR 0007) and no Quote exists yet it answers 503 with type
`urn:sunquote:problem:assistant-budget-exhausted`; the budget resets at 00:00
Europe/Istanbul. After a Quote was created, a spent budget gives the fixed confirmation.

503.description: Assistant not configured / Assistant unavailable / Assistant budget exhausted

post.summary: Create a Quote from a Turkish chat message

post.description:
Size a system for the Customer's Site and return the Quote.

Each client IP may create 10 Quotes an hour (configurable); past that the answer is `429`
with a `Retry-After` header, whatever the body holds.

Give the Site Address or both Coordinates. Coordinates take precedence when both are
given. An Address lookup records the resolved match in the Quote's Assumptions.

The Quote holds a Consumption-Matched System Option and, when its panel count differs, a
Roof-Max one after it. Neither is marked as recommended. Both are capped by the Contracted
Power (given, or the Subscriber Group's default: the cap uses the largest Catalog inverter
within it) and each has its first-year production, its
inverter (AC power at most the Contracted Power) and its price in TRY (Installation Cost,
Sale Price, VAT and total, whole lira). Prices in a foreign currency (USD in the placeholder
data) are converted with TCMB's forex selling rate of the last business day before today,
unless `exchange_rate_override` is given.

Each option also carries its own first-year Annual Savings, Payback Period, lifetime savings
and yearly cash flow, from the residential tariff (marginal Tariff Tiers, applied per
month). Escalation rates are real, so all of these are in today's lira.

The Quote also carries a `narrative`: the prose of its document (greeting, summary, a
comparison of the two options, next steps) with every figure filled from the Quote. When a
Narrative writer is configured it writes the text and the source is `llm`; with none, or
when it fails, times out or breaks the rules, the fixed Turkish text is used and the
source is `fallback`. The Narrative never makes the request fail.

The Quote is stored with a Quote Number and a valid-until date and never changes afterwards.
A failed request stores nothing.

422.description: Request validation failed / Unsupported Subscriber Group / No viable system / No compatible inverter / Location not supported / Address not found
